findings.title: 2 z-index value(s) shared by different fixed overlays
findings.fix: Assign a single explicit stacking order (cookie banner < chat < mobile bar < modal). Equal z-index on fixed elements means paint order decides, and an overlay can sit on top of the mobile call button.

findings.title: 12 lead-eligible page(s) render NO lead form
findings.fix: Add a compact 3-field form (name / phone / email) or at minimum a prominent CTA block linking to /free-home-valuation or /contact. Traffic with no capture is wasted spend.

findings.title: 12 page(s) with no clickable tel: link
findings.fix: Add (813) 733-7907 visible on mobile. Real estate converts by phone; a page without a tappable number loses the call.

findings.title: 89 literal title(s) exceed 60 chars once the 16-char template suffix is added
findings.fix: Each title must be <= 44 characters so the rendered title fits in 60. Put the primary keyword first so that if it is truncated, the important words survive.

findings.title: 10 page(s) with no detectable H1
findings.fix: Add exactly one H1 containing the primary keyword. A page with no H1 gives Google nothing to match the query against.

findings.title: 1 referenced asset path(s) do not exist in public/
findings.fix: Fix the paths or add the files. Define shared asset paths as a single exported constant so they cannot drift again. A broken image in schema or an author avatar weakens the entity signal that everything else depends on.

findings.title: 9 page(s) show FAQ content but emit no FAQPage schema
findings.fix: Wrap the same questions in faqSchema(). Visible FAQs without the schema are invisible to AI answer engines and to the FAQ rich result.

findings.title: 7 route(s) missing alternates.canonical
findings.fix: Add `alternates: { canonical: '/the-path' }`. Without a canonical, parameter and trailing-slash variants split ranking signals across duplicates.

findings.title: 4 page(s) with MORE THAN ONE H1
findings.fix: Keep exactly one H1; demote the rest to H2. Multiple H1s split the topic signal.

findings.title: 22 literal title(s) over 60 characters
findings.fix: Trim to under 60 chars with the primary keyword FIRST, or Google truncates it mid-phrase.
